addons.name: Breathing idle
addons.description: Makes a looping 'breathe' animation: the chest rises and falls, the head follows a little.
addons.author: Rigby2D
addons.readme:
# Breathing idle

A looping "breathe" animation in one click, ready to play under other animations.

## Tools

In the **Scripts** menu:

- **Make a breathing idle**: adds a 2.4-second animation named `breathe` (or `breathe 2`, … when
  that name is taken). The selected bones swell and settle; with nothing selected, it uses the bones
  named chest, spine, torso or body. Head and neck bones tilt a little with each breath.

The animation starts and ends on the same pose, so it loops cleanly. Play it on its own track to
keep a character alive while it stands still.

addons.name: Hierarchy select
addons.description: Select a bone's whole chain, its parent, or its siblings, from the Scripts menu.
addons.author: jaisurya-dev-art
addons.readme:
# Hierarchy select

A [Rigby2D](https://rigby2d.com) add-on for moving around a rig quickly.

## Tools

In the **Scripts** menu:

- **Select chain**: adds every bone below the selected bones to the selection. Select the
  shoulder, run it, and the whole arm is selected, ready to key.
- **Select parent**: moves the selection up one level.
- **Select siblings**: selects the bones that share a parent with the selected ones (all the
  fingers of a hand, for example).

They only change the selection, never the rig.

## Install

In Rigby2D, *Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ Add-ons ▸ Get add-ons*, search for **Hierarchy select** and
choose **Install**. Or download it from [rigby2d.com/addons](https://rigby2d.com/addons/).

## Use this as a template

This repository is a small, complete add-on. To make your own:

1. Copy it, rename the repository, and edit `addon_info` in `__init__.py`.
2. Add tools inside `register()` with `@rigby.tool(...)`. The API is in the
   [scripting docs](https://rigby2d.com/docs/scripting.html#api-reference).
3. Publish a GitHub release, then [submit it](https://rigby2d.com/addons/#publish).

addons.name: Mirror tools
addons.description: Mirror the selected bones across X = 0, and swap left and right in their names.
addons.author: Rigby2D
addons.readme:
# Mirror tools

Build one side of a rig, then mirror it.

## Tools

In the **Scripts** menu:

- **Mirror selected bones**: flips the setup position and rotation of the selected bones across
  X = 0.
- **Swap left/right in names**: renames the selected bones (or every bone, when none is selected)
  to the other side: `arm_l` ↔ `arm_r`, `hand.L` ↔ `hand.R`, `leftEye` ↔ `rightEye`. A name that
  is already taken is left alone.

Each tool is one undo step.

addons.name: Rig report
addons.description: Checks the rig before export: empty slots, unused bones, duplicate-looking names and empty animations, listed in the log.
addons.author: Rigby2D
addons.readme:
# Rig report

Catches rigging mistakes before you export.

## Tools

In the **Scripts** menu:

- **Rig report**: checks the open project and lists what it finds in *View ▸ Log*:
  - bones with no children and no slots (often leftovers)
  - slots with no attachments
  - bones whose names differ only by case, spaces or `_` (`Arm_L` and `arm l`)
  - empty animations

It only reads the project: nothing is changed.
